{{Top|leg}}
'''Meta-ceramic''' was a strong, woven material originally developed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to create [[diplomatic pouch]]es that would protect their contents from damage. The meta-ceramic was also woven with [[Computer/Legends|computer]] circuitry, creating an instrument that could also serve as a computer and display a message on its surface.
